speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe exactly how your right groin pain started following that rear-end collision, and tell me if you noticed your leg moving into an abnormal position on its own or if you had to force it?

speaker: Patient
text: 25-year-old female. The patient was involved in a rear-end collision where she was the restrained driver of the back car. She reports immediate onset of pain in both knees and severe pain over the right groin area following the accident.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Anterior Cruciate Ligament (ACL) and Medial Collateral Ligament (MCL) tears of the right knee with associated hip contusion.
